The '''Orbital Space Tug''' was a type of [[Spacetug/Legends|space tug]]. It took the form was an orbiting satellite used for dragging objects into position in space, and was presumably equipped with a [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] or [[Gravity well projector/Legends|gravity well projector]] of some kind.<ref name="The Crystal Star">''[[The Crystal Star]]''</ref>
